## busted checkin
```{r, busted checkin}

library(jsonlite)

J <- fromJSON("evolharvester/tests/hyphy_testers/FMO1_BUSTED.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
csv <- read.csv("evolharvester/tests/hyphy_testers/fmo1_bustedEH.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

###gene-lvl numbers straight from json
U <- J$fits[["Unconstrained model"]][["Rate Distributions"]][["Test"]]
json_vals <- c(
  lrt = J[["test results"]][["LRT"]],
  pval = J[["test results"]][["p-value"]],
  omega_purifying = U[["0"]]$omega,
  omega_neutral = U[["1"]]$omega,
  omega_positive = U[["2"]]$omega,
  proportion_purifying = U[["0"]]$proportion,
  proportion_neutral = U[["1"]]$proportion,
  proportion_positive = U[["2"]]$proportion
)

#####same cols from csv (identical in all row/use row 1)
csv_vals <- unlist(csv[1, names(json_vals)])

####compare with a small tolerance (csv/float rounding makes exact unsafe)
print(data.frame(json = json_vals, csv = csv_vals,
                 match = abs(json_vals - csv_vals) < 1e-8))

####per-partition( branch set, codon range)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(csv))) {
  p   <- as.character(csv$partition[i])
  tb  <- unlist(J$tested[[p]])
  cov <- unlist(J[["data partitions"]][[p]][["coverage"]])
  cat(sprintf("partition %s: branches match = %s | codon range match = %s\n", p,
      setequal(fromJSON(csv$branches[i]), names(tb)[tb == "test"]),
      identical(sprintf("%d-%d", min(cov), max(cov)), csv$partition_codon_range[i])))
}

```
